item.title: Speed bump surfaces 1&2 dangerous for cyclists, 29th September
item.description:
Numerous families commute with their children by bike along this route. It is extremely dangerous when traversing the speed bump surfaces along Fountain drive making for a dangerous bumpy ride and high possibility of crashing on a steep hill as a result. In particular on the left hand side the first 2 bumps when going down the hill have potholes right at the start and all across the surface. This is in stark contrast to the right hand side of the road which has a dedicated cycle lane.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Fountain Drive, Dulwich, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
